data.one_liner: Dart mock library with null safety support and no manual mocks or code generation.
data.what_it_does: Mocktail provides a simple API for creating mocks in Dart without the need for manual mocks or code generation. It uses closures to handle catching TypeError instances when stubbing and verifying return types.
use_when: You want to write unit tests with mocks in Dart or Flutter without running build_runner.
You want a mocking API inspired by mockito that supports null safety out of the box.
avoid_when: You prefer compile-time safe code-generated mocks.
You need to stub or verify extension methods directly.
strengths: No code generation or manual mocks required.
Supports argument matchers and fallback values.
weaknesses: Cannot directly stub or verify extension methods.
Requires registering fallback values for custom types when using argument matchers.
